drums.tags: Funk-rock instrumental. A clean, compressed electric guitar plays a syncopated, percussive riff using 16th-note scratches and double-stops. The electric bass guitar performs a slap-and-pop technique, locking with the kick drum on a syncopated pattern. The drum kit features a tight, high-tuned snare and a dry kick drum. A Hammond organ with a rotary speaker effect provides sustained chordal pads and occasional rhythmic stabs. The tempo is 105 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement is centered around a repetitive groove with subtle variations in the bass fills and guitar voicing.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[percussive clean electric guitar riff enters]
[slap bass enters with syncopated kick drum]

[Main Groove]
[tight snare on beats 2 and 4]
[Hammond organ with rotary effect enters with sustained chords]
[bass performs melodic pops and slides]

[Bridge]
[guitar switches to 16th-note muted scratches]
[organ stabs on the off-beats]

[Outro]
[instruments fade out individually]
[final bass flourish]

vocals.tags: Trap with heavy cinematic sound design elements. The track features a distorted 808 bass that slides between notes, layered with a sharp, metallic snare and crisp hi-hat rolls. A dark, atmospheric synth pad provides a constant harmonic wash in the background. Prominent sound effects include high-velocity bullet whizzes, metallic clinks, and explosive impacts that are synchronized with the rhythmic grid. A high-pitched, dissonant synth lead enters periodically with short, staccato stabs. The tempo is 140 BPM in the key of C minor.
